kultivator.roots.ceremony.start: The testing stones awaken around you. Calm your heart and let your qi flow into them...
kultivator.roots.ceremony.resume: The testing stones remember you and resume their reading...
kultivator.roots.ceremony.running: The testing stones are still reading your root. Be patient.
kultivator.roots.ceremony.reading: The stones are reading your spiritual root...
kultivator.roots.ceremony.converge: The lit stones pour their light into you...
kultivator.roots.step.resonates: The %s stone blazes up: it resonates with you!
kultivator.roots.step.mutant: The rare %s stone awakens: a mutant element!
kultivator.roots.reveal.title: %s-Grade Root
kultivator.roots.verdict.trash: The elders sigh. A trash root... yet many legends began with one. Diligence can move the heavens.
kultivator.roots.verdict.low: A low-grade root. Your road will be long, but every step still counts.
kultivator.roots.verdict.mid: A middling root, neither blessed nor cursed. The Dao rewards those who persist.
kultivator.roots.verdict.high: A high-grade root! Sects would fight over taking you as a disciple.
kultivator.roots.verdict.heavenly: A Heavenly root! Such talent appears once in a generation. The heavens themselves take notice.
kultivator.roots.verdict.single: A single-element root: pure and focused, the rarest of foundations.
kultivator.roots.verdict.mutant: Your root carries the mutant element %s. Hardly one in ten thousand is born with it.
kultivator.roots.verdict.next: Gather qi until your cultivation bar is full, then break through to awaken as a Qi Refining cultivator.
kultivator.roots.broadcast.heavenly: The testing stones blaze for %s: a Heavenly root has appeared in the world!
kultivator.roots.broadcast.mutant: %s was born with the rare mutant element %s!
kultivator.roots.info.reading: being read by the testing stones...
kultivator.roots.info.hint: Use /cultivate root test to begin the testing ceremony.
kultivator.roots.marrow.untested: Your spiritual root has not been tested yet; there is no marrow to cleanse.
kultivator.roots.marrow.wait_ceremony: Wait until the testing stones have finished reading your root.
kultivator.roots.marrow.busy: Your marrow is already being cleansed. Another pill now would tear your meridians apart.
kultivator.roots.marrow.pure: Your root is already Heavenly and pure. Nothing more can be cleansed.
kultivator.roots.marrow.start: The pill burns down to your bones! Black impurities seep out of your pores...
kultivator.roots.marrow.done: Your marrow is cleansed. You now have a %s.
kultivator.roots.marrow.done_max: The pill purges you, but a root cannot rise above Heavenly. It remains a %s.
kultivator.roots.marrow.removed: The impure %s element was washed out of your root!
kultivator.roots.tooltip.effect: Raises your spiritual root one grade (up to Heavenly)
kultivator.roots.tooltip.element: %s%% chance to wash out one element if your root has %s or more
kultivator.roots.tooltip.pain: %s s of agony: Nausea and Hunger II
kultivator.roots.debug.reroll: Root forgotten. The testing ceremony begins anew.
kultivator.roots.debug.replay: The testing stones read your current root once more (no new roll).

advancement.kultivator.mutant_root.descr: Reveal a spiritual root that holds a mutant element
